claims: Jerrod Calhoun is the head men's basketball coach at Utah State University.
Jerrod Calhoun was hired as the head men's basketball coach at Utah State University in 2024.
Jerrod Calhoun is the head coach of the Utah State Aggies from 2024 to present.
Jerrod Calhoun led the Utah State Aggies to a Mountain West title in the 2025-26 season.
Jerrod Calhoun led the Utah State Aggies to an NCAA Tournament win in the 2025-26 season.
Jerrod Calhoun led Utah State to a 29-6 record in the 2025-26 season.
Jerrod Calhoun led Utah State to a 2026 NCAA tournament first-round victory over Villanova.
Jerrod Calhoun was the head coach at Youngstown State from 2017 to 2024.
Jerrod Calhoun was the head coach at Fairmont State from 2012 to 2017.
Jerrod Calhoun spent 7 seasons at Youngstown State.
Jerrod Calhoun is an Ohio native.
Jerrod Calhoun began his coaching career as a student assistant at the University of Cincinnati under Bob Huggins.
Jerrod Calhoun's full bio can be found on the Utah State University Athletics website.
